## Background

The goal of this lab was to create an R function called
gc_content() that calculates the percentage of G and C
bases in a DNA sequence. The function should work with
both uppercase and lowercase letters.

```{r}
gc_content <- function(sequence) {
  # Convert the sequence to uppercase to handle both cases
  sequence <- toupper(sequence)
  
  # Count the number of G and C bases
  g_count <- sum(strsplit(sequence, NULL)[[1]] == "G")
  c_count <- sum(strsplit(sequence, NULL)[[1]] == "C")
  
  # Calculate the total number of bases
  total_bases <- nchar(sequence)
  
  # Calculate the GC content percentage
  gc_percentage <- ((g_count + c_count) / total_bases) * 100
  
  return(gc_percentage)

 } 
```

# Test Results 

```{r}
gc_content("AAAA")
gc_content("GCCG")
gc_content("AtgC")
gc_content("AATGC")
```

# Document Work 

I used GitHub Copilot to help generate a function that calculates the percentage of G and C bases in a DNA sequence. The function was verified by testing four different DNA sequences and comparing the results with manually calculated percentages where all four tests produced the expected results. The function also converts lowercase letters to uppercase.
